title: Production text feature does not execute through the durable executor
owner: WT-00 integration; WT-01 and WT-03 correction
expected: The authenticated CLI action is persisted, the production text handler calls the offline SDK once, stores its reference, and returns executor-completed. A duplicate does not resend.
actual: CLI admission succeeds. Executor returns blocked / UNIMPLEMENTED with no references.
evidence: Expected executor-completed; actual blocked. Runtime result error code UNIMPLEMENTED, retry safe-before-dispatch.
correction: Agree on one certified per-provider-call boundary and a read-only way for features to validate their authoritative task/outbox/claim. WT-01 fencedStore hides tasks/outbox; WT-03 Journal.guard requires those records, and its journal does not invoke WT-01 executeChild. Do not mark the entire multi-call feature single-call or bypass authorization to obtain a passing test.
retestStatus: unresolved; no integrated corrected candidate supplied

title: Inbound router and poll reducer both own inbox/continuation writes
owner: WT-00 integration; WT-02 and WT-05 correction
expected: One transaction commits vote state, reduced inbox disposition and exactly one correlated continuation.
actual: InboundRouter.accept throws STALE_FENCE; standalone poll reduction passes.
evidence: STALE_FENCE from state/sqlite put called by InboundRouter.reduce after createPollReducer updates the same inbox revision.
correction: Assign inbox transition and continuation creation to one component, preserving atomic reduction/handoff. Router must honor unresolved reducer disposition and must not duplicate WT-05 handoffs. Retest early/unknown votes, successful vote, out-of-order replay and duplicate delivery through the actual router.

title: Runtime SQLite file permissions conflict with installer rollback checks
owner: WT-00 integration; WT-01 and WT-08 correction
expected: A database created by the production runtime inside the private host directory meets WT-08 installer stateVersion file checks under an ordinary 0022 umask.
actual: DurableSQLiteStore creates a 0644 database; group/other permission mask is decimal 36 (octal 044), whereas installer requires zero.
evidence: Assertion: WT-01 database cannot be reinstalled/rolled back by WT-08; 36 !== 0. Earlier direct installer invocation against a runtime-created file rejected UNSAFE_STATE_FILE.
correction: WT-00/WT-01 must establish the private-file creation contract for DB/WAL/SHM during host setup without changing unrelated paths or relaxing installer safeguards. Verify clean/repeat install and rollback with a real runtime-created database, pending and unknown records.
retestStatus: unresolved; no integrated corrected candidate supplied
